intent: A tiny loader whose two strokes morph circle → square → triangle while a job runs, then fold in place into a check on success or a cross on error. The same two lines are the loader and the result.

stack.animation: one requestAnimationFrame loop writing SVG path d attributes directly; motion/react for the demo's reveals, cross-fades and useReducedMotion

layout.root: inline-flex span, size × size (default 20px), never resizes between statuses
layout.drawing: viewBox 0 0 24 24, two paths of exactly 36 points each, round caps and joins
layout.halves: every closed shape is sampled by arc length from the top centre, clockwise; path A = right half (top → bottom), path B = left half (bottom → top)
layout.demo: black stage; one 600px card: 52px specimen in an 88–104px tile beside eyebrow + cross-fading title, four step rows with 16px loaders, footer with a count and one button

color.demoCard: #111113, inset 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.08), top highlight 4%, shadow 0 40px 80px -30px rgba(0,0,0,0.9)

motion.loop: 0.9s per shape: hold 32%, then cubic ease-in-out morph into the next; the drawing turns once every 2.6s; speed multiplies the clock
motion.breathing: while a shape travels both halves open into chasing arcs, trimming 2.5% → 10% of the perimeter at each end along sin(π·morph)
motion.fold: a status change captures the current points and interpolates to the new pose: 460ms ease-in-out into check/cross, 320ms ease-out back into the loop; never jumps mid-morph
motion.lifecycle: the loop only runs while loading or mid-fold, pauses offscreen (IntersectionObserver) and in hidden tabs
motion.reducedMotion: no turn, morph or breathing; loading is a still open outline; status changes are instant except the colour

responsive: The loader is a fixed-size glyph; the demo card is a @container: the specimen tile grows from 88 to 104px and padding from 20 to 28px at @md; rows truncate their label before their meta.
accessibility: The SVG is aria-hidden; a visually hidden role=status aria-live=polite span carries label, successLabel or errorLabel.
announce={false} drops the live region when a parent already announces the state.
Demo buttons are real buttons with 2px focus-visible rings offset on #111113 and a 0.97 press scale; Publish is disabled at 40% while running.
